title: IT incident policy
text: An IT downtime longer than 90 minutes requires escalation to the on-call coordinator.

title: IT incident policy
text: An IT downtime longer than 120 minutes requires escalation and incident review.

title: Fraud triage policy
text: More than 7 fraud alerts per hour require a manual review.

title: Supplier continuity
text: A supplier outage longer than 60 minutes requires a backup assessment.

title: Access incidents
text: Any unauthorized access event requires an incident record and security review.
